title: About Ticketzy
lead: Ticketzy is an event ticketing site for concerts, football matches and comedy shows, with live seat maps and QR tickets.

what.title: What it is
what.text: You pick an event, choose seats on a map or a ticket type, pay, and get a QR ticket that is scanned at the door. Organizers build the seat layout of their venue, publish events and check people in. Everything works in English, Korean, Russian and Uzbek, in a light and a dark theme.

items.title: Buyers
items.text: Find events, hold seats for a short time while paying, keep tickets in one place and ask for a refund before the deadline.

items.title: Organizers
items.text: Design venues, set ticket types, follow sales and payouts, message the team and scan tickets at the entrance.

items.title: Administrators
items.text: Approve organizers and events, set commission rates, and handle orders and refunds.

portfolio.title: Still under development
portfolio.text: Ticketzy is still under development and does not sell real tickets yet. Payments and payouts are simulated for now, so no real money is charged or sent. It shows how a full ticketing flow can be built and designed.
